name: Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival

bagPolicy.summary: Festival bags must fit the current entry sizing rules and are subject to search. Oversized bags and prohibited items will not be admitted; locker bags may not exceed 18 by 13 by 8.5 inches.
bagPolicy.note: Coachella updates allowed and prohibited items for each edition. Check the current official support and safety page immediately before travel.

parking.note: Free general day parking normally opens at the time stated in the current festival guide. Camping, companion, and Lake Eldorado parking have separate check-in schedules and access rules.

rideshare.note: No pick-ups or drop-offs in Day Parking (use Pick Up & Drop Off location). No pick-ups or drop-offs (use Pick Up & Drop Off location).

concessions.note: Food and beverage vendors operate across the festival and accept credit, debit, and mobile payment. Camping food and beverage rules differ from venue rules.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
